title: Find places v2 on dev: the capabilities door reports the depth limits a search really runs with, geocoding skips a defunct historic boundary ranked first (Nha Trang centre was at sea), and site checks are queued as soon as results arrive instead of one poll period later
steps: S1: read GET /api/website-opportunities/capabilities with the operator's place limit at its default, then lowered.
S2: geocode a city whose Nominatim answer ranks a defunct (historic) boundary first, with the place node of the same name further down.
S3: a search lands; the page polls /site-checks with a leading poll, a plain poll, a hidden page and a failing read.
expect: S1: search.depths names the limit a search really runs with (quick 20, standard 60 by default; lowered when the operator lowers gmapsMaxPlaces).
S2: the place node's centre is used, not the historic boundary's.
S3: the leading poll reads at once then every period; a plain poll waits one period; a hidden page skips the read but keeps the loop; a failed read does not stop it.
evidence: Dev round tasks/evidence-wo-find-v2/dev-round.md (19/10/2026, dev 11749238ad): V4 Đà Nẵng 10 km Standard returned 38 places / 2 pages while the screen promised 60; Nha Trang 3 km returned 1 place because Nominatim's first row was the dissolved city boundary centred at sea; a reload within 3 s of a search queued no site checks
fence: The capabilities door computes depths from the same min(depth, gmapsMaxPlaces) the search uses; geocode prefers a place node over a historic boundary of the same name; usePoll's leading option fires the first read synchronously

tests: geocode skips a defunct (historic) boundary for the place node of the same name
a leading poll reads at once, then every period
a plain poll waits one period before its first read
a hidden page skips the read but keeps the loop going; a failed read does not stop it
